assumptions: One float32 addition is counted per output element.
The byte ledger is compiler cost analysis: two 1179648-byte inputs and one 1179648-byte output.
The 197 TFLOP/s BF16 peak is only a loose compute ceiling for this float32 vector operation.
The 800 GiB/s HBM figure is the vendor theoretical peak; no empirical bandwidth efficiency factor is applied.
Measured time is the median of three post-warmup candidate executions from the authoritative verifier.
Launch, synchronization, vector-unit limits, VMEM traffic, and compiler scheduling are not represented in the idealized roofline floor.
hardware_label: one TPU v5e chip, theoretical ceilings
name: G5 S1 binary add on one TPU v5e chip
